questions.q: Which ancient seafaring people lived in today's Lebanon?
questions.why: They spread the alphabet around the Mediterranean.

questions.q: In which year did Lebanon gain independence from France?
questions.why: Independence Day is 22 November.

questions.q: Which war divided Lebanon from 1975 to 1990?
questions.why: The Taif Agreement ended it.

questions.q: Which great explosion devastated Beirut's port in 2020?
questions.why: It was caused by stored ammonium nitrate.

questions.q: Which 1989 agreement ended the civil war?
questions.why: It was signed in Saudi Arabia.

questions.q: Which Phoenician city was besieged by Alexander the Great in 332 BC?
questions.why: He built a causeway to reach the island city.

questions.q: Which ancient purple dye made Tyre rich?
questions.why: It was made from sea snails.

questions.q: Which 1958 crisis saw US Marines land in Beirut?
questions.why: President Chamoun asked for help.

questions.q: Which agreement of 1943 shared power among religious groups?
questions.why: It was unwritten.

questions.q: Which ancient Roman temples stand in the Beqaa Valley?
questions.why: Its Temple of Bacchus is very well preserved.

questions.q: Which Phoenician city gave its name to the Bible ('biblion')?
questions.why: It is one of the oldest continuously lived-in cities.

questions.q: What was Lebanon's capital called in Roman times?
questions.why: It had a famous law school.

questions.q: What is the capital of Lebanon?
questions.why: It was once called the 'Paris of the Middle East'.

questions.q: Which sea lies along Lebanon's coast?
questions.why: The coast is about 225 km long.

questions.q: Which grotto with stunning caves is a natural wonder finalist?
questions.why: It has upper and lower caves.

questions.q: Which valley with old monasteries is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It is called the Holy Valley.

questions.q: Which fertile valley lies between two mountain ranges?
questions.why: It is famous for its wineries.

questions.q: What is Lebanon's highest mountain?
questions.why: It is 3,088 m high.

questions.q: Which singer is called the 'Soul of Lebanon'?
questions.why: She has sung since the 1950s.

questions.q: Which Lebanese pop star is famous for 'Akhasmak Ah'?
questions.why: She is one of the Arab world's best-selling singers.

questions.q: Which Lebanese director's 'Capernaum' was Oscar-nominated?
questions.why: It won the Jury Prize at Cannes in 2018.

questions.q: Which Lebanese-American poet wrote 'The Prophet'?
questions.why: It was published in 1923.

questions.q: Which French-Lebanese author wrote 'Leo Africanus' and won the Prix Goncourt?
questions.why: He joined the Académie française in 2011.

questions.q: Which Prime Minister was killed by a huge car bomb in 2005?
questions.why: It led to the Cedar Revolution.

questions.q: Which tree is on Lebanon's flag?
questions.why: Cedars of Lebanon are mentioned in the Bible.

questions.q: Which parsley and bulgur salad is a Lebanese classic?
questions.why: It is mostly parsley.

questions.q: What is Lebanon's currency?
questions.why: It is also called the lira.

questions.q: Which minced meat and bulgur dish is the national dish?
questions.why: It can be fried, baked or raw.

questions.q: Which bread salad with crispy pita and sumac is popular?
questions.why: It uses leftover bread.

questions.q: Which thyme flatbread is a breakfast favourite?
questions.why: It is topped with za'atar.
